en_title: Jeremy Renner Says the Avengers Will Lose in Doomsday and It's 'Their Fault' Because They 'Didn't Call' Hawkeye
cn_title: 雷纳：没叫鹰眼，复仇者恐怕会输
subtitle: 输了可别怪鹰眼
opus_summary: 杰瑞米·雷纳确认不会出演《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》，笑称复仇者没叫鹰眼帮忙，恐怕会输，责任在他们。他是否会在《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》中回归仍不明确。

paragraphs.en: Marvel star Jeremy Renner said the Avengers will lose in Doomsday , and it's "their fault" because they didn't give Hawkeye a call.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威影星杰瑞米·雷纳表示，复仇者们会在《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中落败，而且「是他们自己的错」，因为他们没叫鹰眼帮忙。

paragraphs.en: The original Avengers star confirmed he wouldn't help fight against Doctor Doom's quest to conquer the multiverse during what appears to be a Q&A segment from last month. In a highlight from the interview, captured and shared on X/Twitter by user @drdoomarchive , Renner confirmed that he's "not in" Avengers: Doomsday when it premieres this December.
paragraphs.cn: 在一段似乎来自上个月的问答环节中，这位初代《复仇者联盟》的主演确认，自己不会参与阻止毁灭博士征服多元宇宙的战斗。X用户@drdoomarchive截取并分享了这次访谈的片段，其中雷纳确认，自己「没有出演」今年12月上映的《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》。

paragraphs.en: That might come as a disappointment for fans of his bow-and-arrow hero, especially considering some of his previous teases suggested he may show up in the Marvel Cinematic Universe again. Alas, it seems his long-awaited return as Hawkeye remains on pause. He doesn't seem too bitter about his absence, but that doesn't mean he isn't willing to take a few jabs at the team.
paragraphs.cn: 喜欢这位弓箭英雄的粉丝可能会感到失望，尤其是雷纳此前曾暗示，自己可能再次出现在漫威电影宇宙中。可惜，大家期待已久的鹰眼回归，似乎仍然没有进展。雷纳看起来并没有因为缺席而太过耿耿于怀，不过这不妨碍他拿复仇者们调侃几句。

paragraphs.en: "Doomsday, I'm not in," Renner said. "So, the Avengers will probably lose, just so you know."
paragraphs.cn: 雷纳说：「我没有出演《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》。所以先告诉你们一声，复仇者们恐怕会输。」

paragraphs.en: He added with a laugh, "They didn't call me, so it's their fault they're gonna lose."
paragraphs.cn: 他笑着补充道：「他们没叫我，所以输了就是他们自己的错。」

paragraphs.en: Despite lacking Hulk's superpowered strength or the ability to alter reality like Scarlet Witch, Renner's take on Clint Barton has remained a fan-favorite amongst MCU fans since he first appeared as the character in 2011's Thor. He eventually went on to graduate from that cameo role to be a leading hero in projects like the original Avengers, Avengers: Age of Ultron, and Captain America: Civil War, and he eventually led as the main character in Disney+'s 2021 series Hawkeye , too. That said, he's not always shown up for every fight against evil.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然没有浩克的超强力量，也不能像绯红女巫那样改变现实，但自从雷纳在2011年的《雷神》中首次饰演克林特·巴顿以来，他塑造的这个角色一直深受漫威电影宇宙粉丝喜爱。此后，他从客串角色成为《复仇者联盟》《复仇者联盟2：奥创纪元》和《美国队长3：内战》等作品中的主要英雄之一，并在Disney+于2021年推出的剧集《鹰眼》中担纲主角。不过，他并非每次对抗邪恶都会到场。

paragraphs.en: Renner infamously sat out 2018's Avengers: Infinity War, which saw its gaggle of heroes and stars truly lose their first fight when Thanos snapped half of the universe into dust. The running joke is, well, if Hawkeye had been around to help, Thanos wouldn't have been so lucky. Now that the character seems to be left out again for Doomsday, Renner can't help but see what's coming.
paragraphs.cn: 雷纳缺席2018年的《复仇者联盟3：无限战争》一事广为人知。在那部电影中，灭霸打了个响指，让宇宙中一半的生命化为尘埃，众多英雄与明星也真正遭遇了首次败仗。大家一直拿这件事开玩笑：要是鹰眼当时在场帮忙，灭霸可就没那么走运了。如今，这个角色似乎又被排除在《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》之外，雷纳不免觉得自己已经看到了结局。

paragraphs.en: Of course, he did show up to help finish the fight for the Infinity Stones in Avengers: Endgame, which, coincidentally, saw the heroes win the day (for the most part). Marvel invited fans to revisit that saga-ending story with its Encore re-release last month. Renner said he was excited to see it in theaters at the time.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，他在《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》中确实现身，帮助英雄们结束了争夺无限宝石的战斗。巧的是，那一次英雄们赢了——至少大体如此。漫威上个月通过Encore重映，邀请粉丝重温这段为整个篇章画上句号的故事。雷纳当时表示，他很期待在影院观看这部电影。

paragraphs.en: "They're releasing the Encore of Endgame, I think next week or something, right?" he said. "I'm actually excited to see that. I'm going to take my daughter to see it. She was a little young when it came out prior, so I'm excited that's coming out."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》的Encore重映，我记得是下周左右，对吧？我还挺期待去看的。我会带女儿一起去。上次上映时她还太小，所以我很高兴这部电影要重映了。」

paragraphs.en: With Renner set to sit out Avengers: Doomsday when it premieres December 18, 2026, we'll have to see if he slips back into his superhero suit for 2027's Avengers: Secret Wars. His future as the character largely remains unclear, though comments he made in 2025 suggested he would be open to returning for Hawkeye Season 2 . Any more from that show, which also starred Hailee Steinfeld as Kate Bishop, seems to be on the back burner for now, though.
paragraphs.cn: 雷纳不会出演2026年12月18日上映的《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》，至于他会不会在2027年的《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》中重新穿上超级英雄战衣，还得拭目以待。他今后是否继续饰演鹰眼，仍有诸多不确定之处，不过他在2025年的言论表明，他愿意回归《鹰眼》第2季。只是，这部由海莉·斯坦菲尔德饰演凯特·毕肖普、共同主演的剧集，后续内容目前似乎暂时搁置了。
